name: Koinaka Lovers
source:
This is the fandisc for Koinaka, with after stories in an omnibus format with plenty of icha ero.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
